text: PR #5399 (Windows path-alias rejection) merged as 9f00f388d after two adversarial /code-review passes and a manual full-suite workflow_dispatch run of Windows Native Validation (required per-PR checks on v1-development don't build/run the complete test suite -- only main-triggered workflows do; this is a standing gap worth knowing about for any future Windows-side change). First adversarial pass caught and I fixed a real regression from an earlier dedup refactor. Filed 6 sub-issues of #34 for things found but not fixed (#5400-#5405; #5400 is a TOCTOU race in the shared containment primitive, most severe). Also found and fixed (PR #5406, open) a pre-existing, unrelated gap: 3 tests missing native-test-isolation classification, invisible to any per-PR check for the same CI-coverage reason. Full detail in agent-handoff.md.
